name: TangBuy Dropshipping
author: tangbuydropshipping

sections.description:
TangBuy Dropshipping is a powerful WordPress plugin that seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce to provide advanced dropshipping functionality. Connect to the TangBuy platform to import products, manage inventory, and process orders efficiently.

Key Features:

  • WooCommerce REST API Optimization – Enhanced performance for batch variation creation
  • Async Image Processing – Non-blocking image downloads with callback system
  • Multi-Scheduler Processing – Parallel image processing for improved speed
  • Auto Performance Configuration – Automatically optimizes based on system resources
  • Variation SKU Support – Complete SKU management for product variations
  • Token Authentication – Secure connection to TangBuy platform

Performance Improvements:

  • Up to 80% faster variation creation
  • Reduced API response times
  • Optimized database operations
  • Smart retry mechanisms

Third Party Service Integration:

This plugin connects to external TangBuy services to provide dropshipping functionality. Please review the service details below before using this plugin.

Third Party Services

This plugin relies on the following external services to function properly:

1. TangBuy Authentication and Product API Services
* Service URLs:
– https://www.tangbuy.com/gateway/plugin/auth
– https://www.tangbuy.com/gateway/plugin/auth/wooRedirect
– https://www.tangbuy.com/gateway/plugin/auth/disconnect
* Purpose: User authentication, authorization, and product data synchronization for dropshipping operations
* Data Sent: WordPress site URL, user credentials, authentication tokens, product information, order details
* When: During plugin setup, authentication, product import, and order processing
* Privacy Policy: https://www.tangbuy.com/help/doc/tangbuy_help_center?code=privacy_agreement
* Terms of Service: https://www.tangbuy.com/help/doc/tangbuy_help_center?code=dropshipping

2. TangBuy Logistics and Shipping Services
* What the Service Is and What It Is Used For:
The plugin integrates with third-party logistics providers 17Track to provide shipping tracking and real-time delivery updates. This service is essential for order fulfillment, ensuring that users can track their shipments from our warehouses to their customers’ destinations.
* What Data Is Sent and When:
• Data Sent: The plugin sends shipping order ID, and the logistics provider to generate tracking information.
• When Data Is Sent: Data is sent when an order is processed, and a shipment tracking request is made.
* Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
• This service is provided by 17 Track
• 17Track Terms of Service https://www.17track.net/en/about/licensing
• 17 Tack Privacy Policy https://www.17track.net/en/about/privacy

3. TangBuy Payment Gateway Integration
* What the Service Is and What It Is Used For:
• The Tangbuy Dropshipping plugin connects to third-party payment gateways like AliPay and PayPal to securely process payments. These services facilitate transactions between the customers of your store and the sellers, ensuring smooth payment processing for orders.
* What Data Is Sent and When:
• Data Sent: Payment details such as credit card information and transaction amounts are sent to the payment gateways for processing.
• When Data Is Sent: Data is sent whenever a customer proceeds to checkout and submits payment information.
* Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
• This service is provided by Alipay and PayPal.
• Alipay Terms of Service https://docs.alipayplus.com/alipayplus/legal/docs/terms_of_use
• Alipay Privacy Policy https://docs.alipayplus.com/alipayplus/legal/docs/privacy
• PayPal Terms of Service https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/paypal/useragreement-full?country.x=US&locale.x=en_US
• PayPal Privacy Policy https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/paypal/privacy-full

  • 4.TangBuy Third-Party Authentication for User Account Management (Google, Apple, TikTok)**
  • What the Service Is and What It Is Used For:
    • The Tangbuy Dropshipping plugin integrates with Google, Apple, and TikTok to authenticate user accounts securely. These third-party authentication services allow users to log in to their accounts using their existing credentials from these platforms, providing a seamless and secure experience.
    • Google is used for authentication via Google accounts (Gmail, Google Account) to simplify the login process.
    • Apple allows users to sign in with their Apple ID, ensuring a secure and privacy-focused authentication method for users who prefer Apple’s ecosystem.
    • TikTok is used to authenticate users logging in through their TikTok accounts, primarily for those using TikTok’s commerce features (e.g., creators or sellers using TikTok for marketing and sales).
  • What Data Is Sent and When:
    • Data Sent:
    • Google: The user’s Google account information, including email address, name, and any associated profile data necessary for authentication.
    • Apple: The user’s Apple ID, email address, and any relevant authentication tokens required for logging in.
    • TikTok: The user’s TikTok account information, including username, email address, and user data tied to TikTok commerce (if applicable).
    • When Data Is Sent:
    • During the login or account creation process when the user chooses to authenticate via Google, Apple, or TikTok.
    • Data is transmitted only when the user opts to log in using these third-party services, ensuring that authentication happens securely without the need for the user to create a separate account within Tangbuy.
  • Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:
  • These services are provided by Google, Apple, and TikTok.
    • Google Terms of Service https://policies.google.com/terms
    Google Privacy Policy https://policies.google.com/privacy https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy
    • Apple Terms of Service https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/data/en/sign-in-with-apple/
    Apple Privacy Policy https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww/
    • TikTok Terms of Service https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/terms-of-service/en
    • TikTok Privacy Policy https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/privacy-policy/en

Important Notice:
By using this plugin, you acknowledge that data will be transmitted to TangBuy’s servers for the purposes described above. Please review TangBuy’s privacy policy and terms of service before using this plugin. The plugin requires these external services to function and cannot operate without them.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/tangbuy-dropshipping/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Review the Third Party Services section above and TangBuy’s privacy policy
  4. Configure your TangBuy connection in the plugin settings
  5. Start importing products and managing your dropshipping business
sections.faq:
What data does this plugin send to external services?

This plugin sends the following data to TangBuy services:
– WordPress site URL and basic site information during authentication
– Product data (names, descriptions, prices, images) during product import
– Order information during order processing
– Image processing status during callback operations
All data transmission is encrypted and occurs only when you actively use plugin features.

Is TangBuy service free?

Yes, TangBuy provides free dropshipping services. You can connect and use the platform without any subscription fees.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is specifically designed for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

What PHP version is required?

PHP 7.4 or higher is required for optimal performance and security.

Can I use this plugin without connecting to TangBuy services?

No, this plugin requires connection to TangBuy’s external services to function. The plugin cannot operate in offline mode as it depends on TangBuy’s API for product data, authentication, and order processing.

How is my data protected when using TangBuy services?

All data transmission between your WordPress site and TangBuy services is encrypted using HTTPS/SSL. Please review TangBuy’s privacy policy at https://www.tangbuy.com/help/doc/tangbuy_help_center?code=privacy_agreement for detailed information about data handling and protection.
